links.text: View it as a Web page

body: Each month we share tips to help protect you and your money from fraud. This month's topic: phishing.
Phishing is when scammers use email to trick you into giving them personal or financial information.

Watch for messages that say there's a problem with your account or payment details, ask you to confirm personal information, push you to open an attachment, or say you qualify for something too good to be true.
Scammers also use texts, phone calls and voicemail, and spoofed addresses or websites that change one letter or number to look real.

Still unsure? Look up the company yourself and call to ask. And turn on multifactor authentication.

subject: Action Required: Universal Benefits Application for Summer SUN Bucks
body: We're writing about an important step needed to decide whether your child qualifies for Summer SUN Bucks, which gives qualifying students a summer EBT card for food.
Even if you already turned in the income form, families now also need to submit the Universal Benefits Application for this school year.
Without it, your child may miss out on these benefits.
Please complete the application as soon as possible, and no later than May 30.
If you need help or have questions, contact us; we're happy to help.
